old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-xjhl","title":"Authenticated SCHC fragmentation sessions leak reservations when handles are dropped","description":"Security review P3. New FragmentSender and AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver constructors reserve policy tuples in rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs, but the handles do not borrow/own a release guard and implement no Drop cleanup. Only successful terminal processing or explicit cancel/timeout releases. Dropping a live handle leaves SessionBusy until the 60s inactivity deadline; the next allocation merely converts it to another 60s tombstone and still fails, allowing error/cancellation paths to strand per-peer send/receive capacity for up to two minutes repeatedly. Make reservation ownership RAII-safe or expose a policy cleanup/maintenance path that releases abandoned handles without extending hold-down unexpectedly; add drop/early-return tests for sender and receiver.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:21.773532Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:21.773532Z"}
